cpos.conclusion: Shared platform prefix, not a single tariff authority. Public ladenetz roaming matrix maps DEBCK through Backcharge to many distinct CPOs/brands (including BayWa r.e., Firmenladen, NEW AG, Qwello, LichtBlick and others). Fail closed: resolve downstream physical CPO/EVSE before pricing; no DEBCK-wide tariff.

Official current ad-hoc tariff is 0.69 EUR/kWh. Blocking fee: 0.10 EUR/min after 240 min AC or 120 min DC, capped at 12 EUR generally and 4 EUR at SWHN locations with a parking fee. Kept partial until all canonical DESHN EVSE are confirmed to be tariff-authoritative SWHN assets rather than represented partner assets.

TotalEnergies officially states there is no uniform network price; prices vary by location/payment context and must be read per station in Charge Europe / Find a Charger. Some stations add blocking fees. Therefore DEDES must remain station/EVSE-resolved and no network fallback may be inferred. Summer 2026 0.59 EUR/kWh promotion expired 2026-08-31 and is not current.

Current direct-payment station observations are not uniform: multiple eliso sites show 0.53 EUR/kWh plus 0.12 EUR/min after 60 min, while Ochsenfurt shows 0.49 EUR/kWh plus 0.10 EUR/min after 60 min. These third-party station-level observations are discovery evidence only, so no eliso-wide tariff is promoted without a primary exhaustive source or exact EVSE checkout mapping.

policy: No sampled, promotional, roaming or third-party tariff is generalized beyond its source scope. Shared prefixes remain fail-closed until EVSE-to-physical-CPO resolution is explicit.
